newsitem.title: ETHIOPIA: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Ethiopian birr strengthens against dollar.

text.p: The Ethiopian birr strengthened against the dollar on Monday from last week, the central National Bank of Ethiopia (NBE) said.
It quoted the birr at a mean rate of of 6.8010 against the dollar compared to 6.8530 last week.
It said following a currency auction on June 28 that the applicable rate for all transactions outside the auction in the June 30 to July 6 period would be 6.8010 birr to the dollar.
The central bank posted the birr at a mean rate of 11.3644 against the pound sterling from 11.4273 on Friday and 0.059423 against the yen from 0.060352.
